paragraphs: Civitas Learning sells software that colleges and universities use to turn their own institutional data into predictions and daily operations. It is pitched as covering every stage of the student experience rather than one office.

The predictive models are trained on an institution's own students, programs, and patterns rather than on national averages. The company states those models are institution specific, rescored nightly, and 89% accurate at predicting outcomes. Data is pulled from the student information system, learning management system, customer relationship system, and other campus technology into one foundation. Advisers get suggested next actions to guide their outreach to students.

The founders started the company in 2011 to help institutions apply their data to student outcomes. Presidents, provosts, enrollment, student success, academic affairs, and career teams are named as the people working from it. The company says its AI stays auditable through autonomy tiers, contact caps, and a full run history.
